channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Dave Joerger | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Dave Joerger from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Vivek Ranadive on Vlade Divac, Dave Joerger
item.description:
Vivek Ranadive:

“Well again, I leave it up to (general manager) Vlade (Divac). What I see is a young guy who wants to win, and has actually matured. And I'm just repeating what I hear Vlade saying, so it's better to ask him this question, but I think what Vlade really wants to see is - and the way he says it with his Serb accent - is hugs (laughs). Hugs. He wants to see hugs, and he wants to see growth as a teammate. I know that Vlade and coach (first-year coach Dave Joerger, formerly of the Memphis Grizzlies) will make the right decisions, and I don't know. Right now what I see is I'm excited for what we have.”

Vivek Ranadive on Vlade Divac, Dave Joerger, Oct 10, 2016. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Willie Cauley-Stein on Dave Joerger
item.description:
Blake Ellington:Willie Cauley-Stein on Dave Joerger:

“He just cares about his guys I feel like. I feel like I've known him longer than what I have.”

Willie Cauley-Stein on Dave Joerger, Oct 9, 2016. Source: Twitter @BlakeEllington.

item.title: DeMarcus Cousins on Dave Joerger
item.description:
Jason Jones:DeMarcus Cousins on being on the driving range vs. Dave Joerger:

“Oh I killed coach. I’m not that bad actually. I’m not that bad.”

DeMarcus Cousins on Dave Joerger, Jun 16, 2016. Source: Twitter @mr_jasonjones.

item.title: Kosta Koufos on Dave Joerger
item.description:
Kosta Koufos (on his potential defensive impact):

“I’m sure he’ll be able to bring that defensive mindset and have us all buy in. It’s a new start and a new look. Coach Joerger knows what he’s doing on that side of the floor.”

Kosta Koufos on Dave Joerger, May 9, 2016. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Robert Pera on Dave Joerger
item.description:
“I am excited to announce that we have reached an agreement to extend Dave Joerger as the head coach of the Memphis Grizzlies,”

Robert Pera on Dave Joerger, May 27, 2014. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Lionel Hollins on Dave Joerger
item.description:
Geoff Calkins:Hollins on Joerger:

“He wasn't a defensive coach until I made him the defensive coach.”

Lionel Hollins on Dave Joerger, Jun 3, 2013. Source: Twitter @geoff_calkins.

item.title: Lionel Hollins on Dave Joerger
item.description:
“To me, that’s ludicrous. …It’s puzzling when I hear comments like that. I love Dave Joerger. We have a great rapport. We’ve spent every summer, since I elevated him to my first assistant, talking philosophy and concepts.”

Lionel Hollins on Dave Joerger, Jun 3, 2013. Source: Memphis Commercial Appeal.
